description: Every plugin engineering-review can run, and the changed paths that make it relevant. A plugin is selected when at least one changed file matches one of its include patterns and none of its exclude patterns. Patterns are globs over repository-relative paths: * matches within one path segment, ** matches any number of segments, and a pattern with no slash matches the file name anywhere. Each plugin's triggers mirror its own early stop, so the plan does not select a plugin that would then do nothing; the plugin's own detector stays the authority when it runs.

plugins.name: four-pass-review
plugins.cost: 4 reviewer agents, plus up to 6 lightweight verifiers
plugins.summary: Completeness, correctness, compliance and consistency, in four parallel passes.

plugins.name: migration-safety
plugins.summary: What the change's database migrations break in production.

plugins.name: change-impact
plugins.summary: What the change touches and what reaches it: callers, routes, jobs, schedules, tests.

plugins.name: regression-hunter
plugins.cost: 1 reviewer agent, only when fixes or reverts touched the changed lines
plugins.summary: Whether the change undoes an earlier fix, re-introduces reverted code, loosens a regression test, or leaves a usual partner file behind.

plugins.name: test-gap-writer
plugins.summary: Writes tests that prove correctness and completeness findings. Edits test files, so it is offered after the review and never run without asking.
